context_snapshot.goal:
Implement all child tasks of epic hermes-guide-qq1: feat: LightRAG Retrieval Evaluation Harness. Add a deterministic retrieval evaluation harness for hermes-guide.

## Why This Exists

hermes-guide has one live smoke test that checks a handful of words. A deploy can silently degrade Hermes coaching quality â bad retrieval behind HTTP 200 â with no observable signal. This epic adds a repeatable benchmark that catches regressions before they reach users.

## Scope

- Curated JSONL eval cases (14 initial: coding, research, media, productivity, DevOps, mixed-intent, SOUL.md variants, negative relevance)
- Fixture responses for CI-safe runner testing (no live LightRAG calls required)
- CLI runner: calls /query, scores keyword/structural checks, exits nonzero on failure
- Unit tests for runner scoring logic (TDD approach)
- Makefile targets: make eval / make eval-live / make eval-fixture / make test
- GET /config endpoint exposing non-secret retrieval configuration
- README eval section

## Out of Scope (Phase 1)

- LLM judge / answer-quality scoring
- Running live evals on every CI push
- Rerank benchmark comparison tooling

## Plan
